description:
A practical commuter ebike built with a 1500W motor, 48V 20Ah battery, up to 45 miles of range, front suspension comfort, and 26" city-ready tires for everyday riding.

1500W Motor Smooth commuter power

25 MPH Top Speed Efficient daily cruising

48V 20Ah Battery High-capacity power

Up to 45 Miles Range Ride farther between charges

26" x 2.0" Tires City-ready rolling comfort

350 lbs Payload Built for riders and gear

1500W Motor
25 MPH Top Speed for Everyday Speed
The PostJoy F29 is powered by a 1500W motor and reaches speeds of up to 25 MPH, giving you smooth acceleration and efficient performance for daily commuting.
Whether you're riding to work, running errands, or cruising through city streets, the F29 helps you move faster with less effort.

48V 10Ah Battery
Reliable Power for Daily Rides
The F29 features a 48V 10Ah battery designed to support everyday travel, longer commutes, and weekend rides without frequent charging.
With high-capacity power on board, you can ride farther and spend less time worrying about your next charge.

Up to 45 Miles Range
Go Farther Between Charges
With up to 45 miles of range, the PostJoy F29 gives you the freedom to handle daily commutes, errands, and city rides with fewer charging stops.
From weekday travel to relaxed weekend cruising, the F29 is ready to keep up with your routine.

26" x 2.0" Commuter Tires
Smooth Rolling for City Streets
The F29 rides on 26" x 2.0" tires, offering a balanced feel for paved roads, bike lanes, neighborhood streets, and daily commuting routes.
The city-ready tire size helps deliver smooth rolling efficiency, stable handling, and a natural riding feel.

Front Suspension Fork
Comfort Where the Road Gets Rough
The front suspension fork helps absorb road vibration and small bumps, making everyday rides smoother and more comfortable.
From uneven pavement to neighborhood roads, the F29 helps reduce harsh impacts so you can ride with more confidence.

Disc Brakes
Confident Stopping Power
The F29 is equipped with disc brakes to deliver reliable stopping performance for city riding, traffic, and changing road conditions.
Whether you're slowing at intersections or navigating busy streets, the braking system helps you stay in control.

7 Speed Drivetrain
More Control for Every Ride
The 7-speed drivetrain gives you flexible gear options for different riding conditions, from flat city streets to gentle hills.
Shift easily to match your pace, terrain, and riding style.

350 lbs Payload Capacity
Built for Riders and Daily Gear
With a maximum payload capacity of 350 lbs, the F29 is built to support a wide range of riders and everyday carrying needs.
Carry a backpack, work essentials, groceries, or riding gear with added confidence.

49.6 lbs E-Bike Weight
Lightweight Feel for Daily Use
At 49.6 lbs, the F29 offers a lighter, easier-to-handle ride compared with heavier moped-style e-bikes.
Its practical commuter build makes it easier to maneuver, park, and ride every day.

IP6 Water Resistance
Ready for Everyday Conditions
With IP6 water resistance, the F29 is designed to handle splashes, wet roads, and changing weather during daily rides.
Ride through everyday outdoor conditions with added peace of mind.
